name: LiDE 300 v5 + stage 2
notes: v5 (2026-09-29): same TinyUNet architecture retrained with focal loss on 328 scans (5/22 Top Offspring + Jul-Sep exports, Sarah's labels), no GBM filter. Held-out test (35 scans: 9/28 Rep 2 + 8/10): F1 96.5 vs 95.6 for v4; dark-pupa recall 92 vs 89, count bias -0.6 vs -4.5 per scan (duplicate-merged scoring). All scans so far are actually 150 DPI; the daemon rescales other DPIs to trainDpi before inference. Stage 2 (2026-09-29): held-out test with the user-reviewed labels F1 97.4 vs 96.8 (v5 alone) vs 95.5 (v4); count bias -1.2 vs -4.1 vs -7.9 pupae per scan; both pupae of an overlapping pair found 71% vs 54% vs 38%.

stage2.note: HistGradientBoosting (sklearn 1.6.1) on 62 features per heatmap local max: predicts 0/1/2/3+ pupae per blob; filters white larvae / faint false positives and splits overlapping pupae. When present, peakThr/minDist/bboxCrop/classifier are not used.
